messages:
jen: heads-up — packaging done for private-installer v1.8.0, artifacts pushed to sealed-bundles.s3.redwood. ready for transport cutover tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
deploy-bot: scheduled release job #r-341234 for channel=private-onprem at 2026-04-02T02:00:00Z. canaries=3, rollback-window=30m. :robot_face:
alex: noted. image pins: we pushed multi-arch tags, but i left a stable pin v1.8.0-20260401. need to confirm transport chunk size — ops wants 100MB slices.
maria: 100MB chunking sounds right for our mirror infra. any signer TTL concerns? last signer job took 12m.
samir: planner: if signer lags > 15m, fallback plan: stop canary rollout and revert to v1.7.9 pinned image, publish hotfix note. is that acceptable?
jen: yes — fallback to v1.7.9 is our conservative fallback. make clear abort criteria in the runbook.
ops-bot: KMS rotation notice: customer-kms-9 scheduled key rollover at 2026-04-02T01:45:00Z for region-eu. if rollover delays signing, operator = @tess to escalate.
tess: @ops-bot thanks. i'll monitor signer queue and cosign pipeline. if cosign verify fails, i'll abort canary.
alex: adding a quick preflight snippet for cosign checks:
```
# verify signatures for bundle
for f in sealed-bundles/*.tar.gz; do
  cosign verify --key k8s://projects/redwood/keys/signer-key $f || echo FAIL:$f;
done
```
maria: also check checksums after chunk reassembly: sha256sum -c bundle.sha256. prefer we run a dry assemble on staging mirror today.
jen: agreed. schedule dry assemble at 12:30 UTC today. louise, can you own that?
louise: on it. i'll run the assemble and post results here by 13:00 UTC.
samir: rollback play details for ops-runbook:
- condition: cosign verification or checksum mismatch OR signer lag > 15m OR >20% canary error rate
- action: deploy-bot abort r-341234, repin traffic to v1.7.9, run quick patch build for diagnostics
- comms: post short note to #customer-success and #incidents if rollback triggered
jen: perfect. please ensure deploy-bot has an abort alias in the runbook.
alex: deploy-bot abort CLI: `deploy-bot abort r-341234 --force --reason "signer-lag or integrity-failure"` — tested on staging.
deploy-bot: ack — abort alias exists and requires 2 approvers for private channel jobs. approval flow: @jen + @samir or @louise.
tess: one more: transporter will stream chunks to offline-carrier. if carrier reports mismatch, carrier agent will auto-hold and emit ticket. we must not retry automatically; manual inspect first.
maria: noted. i've added a metric dashboard for chunk reassembly success and cosign latency. alert thresholds: cosign > 10s per artifact OR reassembly failures > 1 per 1000 -> P1.
jen: thanks everyone. action items: louise run dry assemble, tess monitor signer queue, alex confirm chunk config on mirrors, maria validate dashboards, samir stand by for rollback. i'll post release notes snippet after dry run. :thumbsup:
louise: dry assemble started 12:31 UTC, OOM on one node but requeued to a larger worker, rerunning. will update.
jen: received. if dry assemble doesn't finish by 13:20 we postpone cutover by 1h.
larry (external-bot): security-scan-complete: no high-critical vulns in v1.8.0 bundles.
jen: great. last q: do we want to shorten rollback-window to 15m given signer risk?
samir: keep 30m for canary traffic; but gate automated full rollout to 60m after successful canaries. gives ops buffer.
jen: ok. final plan: cutover 02:00 UTC, canary 30m, full rollout gated to 60m post-canary. abort criteria and commands are in the runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/private-installer-cutover-341234.
maria: will post dashboard links and alert play in 10m.
louise: dry assemble green at 12:58 UTC. all chunks reassembled and cosign verified. no checksum drift.
tess: signer queue stable, cosign latency avg 4.2s. ready to proceed.
jen: thanks team — proceeding to scheduled cutover unless anyone raises a blocker in next 15m. :rocket:
